high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "fingersindia." The post features a product advertisement for a pair of TWS (True Wireless Stereo) earbuds called "Size Zero Pods2." The earbuds are shown in a peach-colored shade, which is identified as Pantone 13-1023, labeled as "Peach Fuzz." The background of the image is a gradient of soft peach tones, complementing the color of the earbuds. The earbuds are displayed in two positions: one is floating above the other, and both are shown with their charging case
